tasks.title: Implement OpenAI API client and prompt engineering
tasks.description: Create AI client with streaming support and context-aware prompt templates - COMPLETED with production-ready implementation in lib/ai/client.ts (289 lines) and lib/ai/prompt.ts (199 lines)
tasks.details:
✅ IMPLEMENTATION COMPLETE

Files Created:
1. lib/ai/client.ts (289 lines) - OpenAI SDK wrapper with:
   - AIClient class with streaming (streamChat) and non-streaming (chat) methods
   - Abort controller support via AbortSignal parameter
   - Automatic retry logic with exponential backoff for rate limits (429) and server errors (500/503)
   - Token estimation (estimateTokens) and context truncation (truncateMessages) to stay under 8k limit
   - MOCK_AI environment variable support for development without API costs (generateMockStream)
   - Configuration management (getConfig, updateConfig)
   - Error handling with detailed logging

2. lib/ai/prompt.ts (199 lines) - System prompt templates with:
   - buildSystemPrompt() for code context-aware system prompts
   - Language-specific instructions for 20+ languages (typescript, javascript, python, java, rust, go, cpp, c, ruby, php, swift, kotlin, dart, html, css, sql, shell, yaml, json, markdown)
   - buildMessages() function for complete OpenAI message array construction
   - convertMessagesToOpenAI() for Message to ChatCompletionMessageParam conversion
   - PROMPT_TEMPLATES for common tasks (review, explain, optimize, security, refactor, test, document, debug)
   - detectPromptIntent() for automatic intent detection
   - enhancePrompt() to improve user prompts based on detected intent
   - formatCodeContext() for proper code snippet formatting

Dependencies Installed:
- openai@4.20.0 (verified in package.json:54)

Integration Notes:
- Project uses Vercel AI SDK in app/api/chat/route.ts for streaming responses
- Custom AIClient provides additional features: MOCK mode, token management, retry logic
- Both implementations coexist: Vercel AI SDK for edge runtime, custom client for flexibility
- Environment variables: OPENAI_API_KEY (required), MOCK_AI (optional for development)

Key Features:
- Streaming support with real-time chunk callbacks (onChunk, onComplete, onError)
- Request cancellation via AbortController.signal
- Automatic message history truncation to prevent token limit errors
- Retry mechanism: MAX_RETRIES=3, INITIAL_RETRY_DELAY=1000ms, exponential backoff
- Token estimation: ~4 chars per token approximation
- Context window: DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS=8000 for gpt-4o-mini
- Mock mode with simulated streaming for testing without API costs

The implementation follows TypeScript best practices with comprehensive type definitions, JSDoc comments, and proper error handling.
tasks.testStrategy:
Manual testing required:
1. Test streaming responses: Verify streamChat() delivers chunks progressively and calls onComplete callback
2. Test prompt templates: Validate buildMessages() generates contextual prompts with language-specific instructions for different code languages (typescript, python, rust, etc.)
3. Test retry logic: Simulate rate limit errors (429) and server errors (500/503) to verify exponential backoff behavior
4. Test mock mode: Set MOCK_AI=true and verify generateMockStream() produces realistic streaming behavior
5. Test token management: Create messages exceeding 8k tokens and verify truncateMessages() keeps system message and recent history
6. Test abort controller: Trigger signal.abort() during streaming and verify clean termination
7. Test intent detection: Verify detectPromptIntent() correctly identifies intents (review, explain, optimize, security, etc.)
8. Integration test: Connect AIClient to app/api/chat/route.ts and verify end-to-end streaming in the UI

No automated tests exist yet - consider adding Jest/Vitest tests for:
- Token estimation accuracy
- Message truncation logic
- Prompt template generation
- Intent detection patterns
- Mock streaming behavior

subtasks.title: Implement retry logic with exponential backoff
subtasks.description: Add retry mechanism for rate limits (429) and server errors with exponential backoff strategy
subtasks.details:
✅ COMPLETED

Implemented in lib/ai/client.ts:117-149:
- retryWithBackoff<T>() private method with generic retry logic
- Parameters: fn (async function), retries (default MAX_RETRIES=3), delay (default INITIAL_RETRY_DELAY=1000ms)
- Retry conditions:
  - status === 429 (Rate limit)
  - status === 500 (Server error)
  - status === 503 (Service unavailable)
  - code === 'ECONNRESET' (Connection reset)
  - code === 'ETIMEDOUT' (Timeout)
- Exponential backoff: delay doubles on each retry (1s → 2s → 4s)
- Detailed logging: console.log with retry count and delay
- Applied to both streamChat() (line 202) and chat() (line 248)
